mapper.sql: pe.id, pe.elder_id, e.name as elder_name, pe.exam_date, pe.exam_org, pe.exam_type, pe.vision_left, pe.vision_right, pe.hearing, pe.ecg_result, pe.blood_routine, pe.urine_routine, pe.liver_function, pe.kidney_function, pe.lipid_profile, pe.blood_sugar_fasting, pe.blood_sugar_postprandial, pe.ultrasound, pe.x_ray, pe.ct_mri, pe.overall_assessment, pe.health_suggestions, pe.report_url, pe.create_time, pe.update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM physical_exam pe LEFT JOIN elder e ON pe.elder_id = e.id ORDER BY pe.exam_date DESC
SELECT FROM physical_exam pe LEFT JOIN elder e ON pe.elder_id = e.id WHERE pe.elder_id = #{elderId} ORDER BY pe.exam_date DESC
SELECT FROM physical_exam pe LEFT JOIN elder e ON pe.elder_id = e.id WHERE pe.exam_type = #{examType} ORDER BY pe.exam_date DESC
